v3d.pocos: There are not enough points in the series to animate the orbit.
v3d.caption: The **shape and size of the orbit** in each frame are the real simulated result (orbital migration, tidal circularization). The **planet's spinning motion** is illustrative, to give a sense of orbit — the engine does not integrate the fast orbital position (hours/days), only the slow evolution of its parameters on a scale of billions of years.
v3d.caption.lunas: The moon distance(s) are rescaled so they are visible (not to real scale), and they rotate at illustrative speeds only -- they do not reflect their real orbital speeds relative to each other.
